scope: Targeted mechanism validation; shapes chosen after inspecting development data, not an independent generalization benchmark.
stop_and_preserve_logs: Hardware or P2P topology does not match package requirements
Build, source identity, input identity or numerical correctness check fails
Runtime environment changes during a resumed stage
Insufficient time to start the next bounded process
required_analysis_before_any_refit: Score exactly frozen predictions; do not rescale against fresh anchor labels first
Compare repeat anchors with old medians, raw process directions, complete algorithm configurations and environment records
Report absolute percentage errors per candidate and macro averaged by shape, plus maximum error
Report all observed candidate pairs, signed predicted and measured differences, agreement across process blocks and relative loss of wrong directions
Report choices separately for all measured stable candidates, compiler host versus fused, and fused only
Report incomplete or quality-excluded candidates and restrict all optimum claims to the observed comparable subset
Keep warmup diagnostics separate from primary metrics
Keep changed environments or algorithms explicit; never silently pool or relabel the new context as the old one
challenger_requirement: No promotion based only on mean error. Inspect direction count and maximum/mean choice loss against the primary on the same measured subset, plus the specific M256 and host failures. Any tradeoff requires an explicit new review; no automatic model or threshold change.
after_frozen_review: Preserve this package and results. Any refit, new expression, new runtime or altered quality rule receives a separate experiment and identity.
